[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='40px' up='' down='']
Nusa Lembongan is the ideal place to learn to surf or get a few lessons to re-ignite your surfing confidence. Find out more on the links below.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column][vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""14"" padding_bottom=""40"" css_animation=""""][vc_column][portfolio_list type=""standard"" masonry_space=""no"" columns=""3"" order_by=""title"" order=""ASC"" lightbox=""no"" show_like=""no"" category=""surf pay""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column][vc_column_text][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']

Nusa Lembongan is home to some world-class waves and has surf-able waves all year round. The island has three main breaks that can be enjoyed by the beginner to the more experienced surfer. All breaks are dependent on tides with best conditions on mid to high tides.
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']

Playgrounds is an easy surf spot to get to. A short paddle from Coconuts Beach, it is a sheltered reef break providing reliable and enjoyable surf conditions. It has a fun, long left and (depending on the tide) a shorter barrelling right-hander. On a smaller swell Playgrounds is an ideal spot for beginners and often referred to as a “party wave”.
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']

Located just to the right of Playgrounds, this right hander is great learner wave, ideal for beginners on a small to medium swell.  A short paddle from Playgrounds or a quick boat ride from shore. Lacerations is best at mid tide.
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']

A right hand break for the more experienced surfer. The main take off point is a peak that jacks up in one section with great tubing sections and fast walls to race through. There is also another take-off point further in that is a fun walling wave with also plenty of power. Be aware, on 2m+ swell this spot can produce some sneaky bomb sets. A boat ride is required to get to Shipwrecks and is best on mid to high and high going to low.
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down='']

Located on Ceningan Island, when there is no swell at Nusa Lembongan take a 15 minute boat ride to this point break for a fun 2-4 foot lefthander. Best on a mid-tide, this wave has some testing sections to make. Tends to close out on larger swells, but a great option when there are no waves at Nusa Lembongan.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='20px' up='' down=''][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]",,2014-12-17,page,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/surf/,,,,,,,,true,2,0,"a:2:{s:4:""data""

Nusa Lembongan and neighbouring islands of Nusa Penida and Nusa Ceningan all offer world class dive sites. There is an abundance of marine life, drop off walls, coral beds, drift dives and you will also encounter manta rays and the unique mola-mola (ocean sunfish).

Non-divers should not feel left out as there is also great snorkelling. Popular spots include Crystal and Gamat Bays. Be mindful that there are strong currents along all coastlines and caution must be taken.

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation="""" bg_type=""no_bg"" padding_left_right=""2""][vc_column][portfolio_list type=""standard"" masonry_space=""no"" columns=""3"" image_size=""square"" order_by=""title"" order=""DESC"" filter=""no"" lightbox=""no"" show_like=""no"" category=""Bungalow NUSA CENINGAN"" title_font_size=""12"" text_align=""left"" link_type=""single_link"" show_load_more_position=""center"" filter_in_grid=""yes""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation="""" bg_type=""no_bg"" padding_left_right=""2""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan bungalows are some of the most cost effective accommodation for your island escape, wonderful options to choose from and we will have you in holiday mode in no time.  Imagine swinging in your hammock, sand beneath your feet and the warm tropical ocean just a stone’s throw away.  Book propped open, fresh juice in your hand, you ponder a swim, a snorkel, a massage. Or perhaps the sound of your bungalow tropical garden whispering in the breeze as you relax poolside transports you to a state of bliss.  These are all real possibilities when choosing your Lembongan accommodation and booking with The Lembongan Traveller.

There is something exotic about so many Nusa Lembongan bungalows.  Choosing a bungalow gives you a real feel for island life.  You somehow feel a little closer to nature without sacrificing your comfort. Bungalow accommodation choices on Lembongan range in size and services. Usually built in the traditional Indonesian “lumbung” style with natural materials of timber and alang alang used in the design to add to the organic feel and experience.  Many include gorgeous open air bathrooms which adds to that sublime island feeling when you stand under the open sky to shower.

Nusa Lembongan bungalow accommodation is often a popular choice with the budget conscious seeking a true island experience.  However, choosing simplicity does not necessarily mean compromising other aspects.  We have listings for under $100 per night that offer ocean views, beachfront access or just a few minutes walk from the beach.  The Lembongan Traveller also lists some luxurious bungalows to choose from for your next holiday that offer resort facilities.  We have bungalow Lembongan accommodation to suit anyone from the intrepid traveller, the honeymooner or family with no need to sacrifice comfort when you make your choice.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""full_width"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row]",,2014-05-30,page,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/bungalows-3/,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Bedroom-1a.jpg,"Bedroom-Tropica Tranquility",,,"Tropica Tranquility, Nusa Lembongan Villas, Lembongan Hotels, Lembongan Resorts, Lembongan Bungalows, Lembongan Villas, The Lembongan Traveller, Nusa Lembongan Hotels, Nusa Lembongan Resorts, Nusa Lembongan Bungalows, Nusa Lembongan Villas,",https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Bedroom-1a.jpg,,true|true|true|true|true,2|2|2|2|2,0,"a:2:{s:4:""data""

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" padding_bottom=""21"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/6""][/vc_column][vc_column width=""2/3""][vc_column_text css=""""]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/6""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" padding_bottom=""21"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/6""][/vc_column][vc_column width=""2/3""][vc_accordion active_tab=""1"" collapsible=""yes"" style=""toggle"" accordion_border_radius=""1""][vc_accordion_tab title=""MONEY EXCHANGE, CREDIT CARDS AND ATMS ON NUSA LEMBONGAN?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]There are a number of places you can exchange money on the island, including one on the main road in front of the Indiana gang in Jungut Batu. Most resorts and restaurants accept credit cards, however cash is required for scooter hire, snorkelling and other day trips. There are a number of ATMs on Nusa Lembongan, but please note they have a cap on the amount you can withdraw &amp
column2: do sometimes run out of money. So best to have some CASH![/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""IS THERE A DOCTOR ON THE ISLAND ?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]If you require medical attention whilst on Lembongan we recommend East Medical Clinic in Mushroom Bay, it is a private practice open 24 hours, 7 days a week.  Whats App +62 813 3955 5515[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""HOW CAN I HELP THE ENVIRONMENT?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]As with so many places, Lembongan is trying to minimise the use of plastic on the island. There are some easy ways you can do your bit to help
column3: bring a re-usable water bottle to avoid having to use plastic water bottles. Also say no to plastic bags when you shop locally, bring a carry bag with you to use rather than accepting a plastic bag.

column1: Water on Lembongan is a scarce resource, so we ask you to think carefully when showering, trying to restrict length of showers and how many you have a day.  This concept also applies to laundering and only request new towels when really needed. Every little bit counts.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""WHERE ARE BEST SWIMMING BEACHES?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]Care is to be taken when swimming in any waters around Nusa Lembongan as there are  variable tides and strong currents. Mushroom Bay, Coconut Beach and Jungut Batu have less currents when staying closer to shore. Swimming at Dream Beach should be done with caution as there are very strong currents. We also ask you take care when visiting Devils Tear and other ocean fronting sights, as freak waves can occur.  CLICK HERE to read our blog about Lembongan's BEST Beaches.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""WHAT TRANSPORT IS ON LEMBONGAN?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text css=""""]Nusa Lembongan is approximately 8km2, with roads linking villas, hotels, restaurants, &
column2: attractions. Scooters are widely available for hire and are the main form of transport around the island.  For those not comfortable driving themselves, willing locals are also more than happy to transport you on the back of their motorbike for a fee. If scooters are not for you, gasoline cars and bicycles are available for hire and guided tours.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""IS LEMBONGAN GOOD FOR KIDS?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text css=""""]Nusa Lembongan is a great place to bring children of all ages. It’s a very safe island and the locals adore children. Be sure to always supervise your children when swimming as the tidal movements and currents can cause issues when unaware of the changing conditions. Choosing your accommodation to suit the needs of your children is one way to ensure the whole family have a great holiday. Decide if you are best suited to a resort style set up with a larger swimming pool or prefer a villa with a private pool.  We have a blog which gives some great ideas for family fun activities.  If you have younger children, there are babysitting services and we can also assist with pool fences.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""HOW DO WE GET TO AND FROM RESTAURANTS?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text css=""""]Many restaurants on Lembongan offer a FREE pick up and drop off service.  This is very handy for families and also those wanting to have a couple of cocktails. Our Restaurant Guide has menus, locations and contact details for all our favourite restaurants on Nusa Lembongan &
column3: Nusa Ceningan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""SHOULD I BRING OR RENT A SURF BOARD?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]This is a personal decision and depends upon many factors including how long you plan to stay, your daily budget and how  long your board is!! There are a number of Surf Schools in Jungut Batu &
column4: Mushroom Bay which rent surf boards. The boards are in good condition and a selection of sizes and styles are on offer, including long, short, soft boards, boogie boards, and stand up paddle boards. If you do decide to bring your board, it is included in your boat transfer ticket - no extra charge for surfboards :)

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""CAN I GET EARLY CHECK IN / LATER CHECK OUT?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]We understand everyone wants to spend as much time as possible island side.  Early check in will always be offered if available, but depends if guests are checking out the same day to give staff time to prepare for your arrival.  Similar for late check out.  Always touch base a few days prior to your arrival.  Noting, standard check in time is 2pm and check out is 10am.  If you are staying at a resort they will always be happy to hold your bags for you until your room is ready or so you can enjoy exploring the island on your last day.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""WHAT ARE THE BOAT TIMES FROM BALI?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan is approximately a 30 minute boat trip from Sanur, Bali. Boats leave up to 4 times daily. Please take a look at our boat transfers page for detailed information about boat options to and from Nusa Lembongan. The last boat from Bali leaves at 5pm.
Depending on your flight schedule or travel plans it is sometimes necessary to overnight in Bali to make connecting boat / flight times.  See HERE for link to hotels in Bali we recommend.

column2: > [/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""IS THERE WIFI ON LEMBONGAN?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]WIFI is available at all restaurants and accommodation. However, be mindful that download speeds do vary, can be slower at times, as servers are located in Bali.  As a whole the island offers consistent wifi capable for online work. If it does drop out, take it as a sign to log off-line and enjoy island life![/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""WHERE DO I BUY VISA ON ARRIVAL?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text css=""""]Visa On Arrival needs to be purchased at Denpasar airport prior to going through immigration.

column1: Ensure your passport has 6 months validity other wise you will not be able to travel to Indonesia.

We also strongly recommend you have travel insurance, ideally taking it out when you make your booking to cover you for any unforeseen circumstances.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""WHAT IS THE RELIGION ON LEMBONGAN?"" title_tag=""h4"" title_color=""#6d6e70"" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column_text]The majority of local people are Hindu. Traditions and religious ceremonies are part of everyday life, you will undoubtedly see at least one during your stay. They are extremely colourful, lively (and loud) events. Respect for the locals during these occasions is appreciated and best shown by thoughtful observance. Balinese is the most common language of communication between local residents. English is widely understood and spoken, often with an Australian accent![/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][/vc_accordion][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/6""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""full_width"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row]",,2014-06-03,page,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/travel-tips/,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Villa-Tranquilla.jpg|https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/travel-tips-banner.jpg,"Villa-Tranquilla|travel tips banner",|,|,"Villa Tranquilla, Sandy Bay Nusa Lembongan, Lembongan Travel Tips|",https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Villa-Tranquilla.jpg,,true|true|true|true|true,2|2|2|2|2,0,"a:2:{s:4:""data""

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#f5f5f5""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Have you been searching for the perfect Nusa Lembongan accommodation or for a different choice of Bali accommodation?  At The Lembongan Traveller we take care of all your Lembongan accommodation needs and handle boat transfers from mainland Bali.  We list a wide range of accommodation choices for Nusa Lembongan villas, resorts, hotels and bungalows to suit any budget. With a wealth of knowledge on all things Nusa Lembongan, we are the ultimate guides and will make your island escape one to remember.  Allow us to assist you with all you need to know about booking accommodation on this beautiful holiday destination.

If you dream of a real island holiday with crystal clear waters and a relaxed village vibe then an escape to Nusa Lembongan is the perfect answer. Just a 30 minute boat ride from Bali, Nusa Lembongan is an idyllic island where you can forget the hustle and bustle of mainland Bali.  An island where the days of old Indonesia are blended harmoniously with the comforts of Nusa Lembongan resort and villa accommodation. Here relaxation and adventure go hand in hand. Nusa Lembongan, Bali has a truly relaxed island atmosphere and will have you feeling like you are miles away from the stresses of life.  The waters are clean and pristine, making Nusa Lembongan a water playground.  Ocean activities take front row with surfing, snorkelling, diving and paddle boarding a popular way to spend the day for holidaymakers and families.

Picture yourself relaxing in your Nusa Lembongan hotel accommodation gazing over turquoise seas, the sound of waves breaking and a mild tropical heat warming your skin.  A rooster can be heard faintly crowing from a local village. The smell of handmade banana pancakes tickles your nose as you ponder the day's activities.  Perhaps a traditional boat ride and snorkelling in the temperate waters where tropical fish abound is on the cards?  Or maybe surfing the infamous breaks of Playgrounds, Shipwrecks or Lacerations are more your style?  Or is it time to unwind poolside in your Lembongan villa and allow your staff to attend to your needs.
If your next Bali holiday break sounds something like this contact us to book your Nusa Lembongan Accommodation.

Surf boards and other larger items will be brought in by airport staff and placed next to the baggage carousel.

If you are yet to discover Nusa Penida, you are missing out!  Nusa Penida day trips are a offered from both Bali and Nusa Lembongan, with options for car or scooter packages, all day trips include a guide.

A popular diving destination, Nusa Penida has a natural beauty, spectacular coastlines and earthy ruggedness that is an eye opener to any seasoned traveller. Nusa Penida is relatively undeveloped from a tourism perspective. A Nusa Penida day trip is a ""MUST do"" if you are keen for adventure and appreciate amazing landscapes.

Some of the key sights to see are Kelingkling Beach, Broken Beach, Angels Billabong, and Atuh Beach.  We also include the local market and Goa Giri Cave on the options from Nusa Lembongan.  Goa Giri Cave is a ""secret""  temple hidden in the hill side which holds strong religious cultural beliefs and is a truly spiritual experience.

This privacy policy applies to the Site and all products and services offered by The Lembongan Traveller.

We may collect personal identification information from Users in a variety of ways, including, but not limited to, when Users visit our site, place an order, and in connection with other activities, services, features or resources we make available on our Site. Users may be asked for, as appropriate, name, email address, mailing address, phone number, credit card information. Users may, however, visit our Site anonymously. We will collect personal identification information from Users only if they voluntarily submit such information to us. Users can always refuse to supply personally identification information, except that it may prevent them from engaging in certain Site related activities.

We may collect non-personal identification information about Users whenever they interact with our Site. Non-personal identification information may include the browser name, the type of computer and technical information about Users means of connection to our Site, such as the operating system and the Internet service providers utilized and other similar information.

Our Site may use ""cookies"" to enhance User experience. User's web browser places cookies on their hard drive for record-keeping purposes and sometimes to track information about them. User may choose to set their web browser to refuse cookies, or to alert you when cookies are being sent. If they do so, note that some parts of the Site may not function properly.
The Lembongan Traveller may collect and use Users personal information for the following purposes:
• To improve customer service: Information you provide helps us respond to your customer service requests and support needs more efficiently.
• To personalize user experience: We may use information in the aggregate to understand how our Users as a group use the services and resources provided on our Site.
• To improve our Site: We may use feedback you provide to improve our products and services.

• To process payments: We may use the information Users provide about themselves when placing an order only to provide service to that order. We do not share this information with outside parties except to the extent necessary to provide the service.

• To send periodic emails: We may use the email address to send User information and updates pertaining to their order. It may also be used to respond to their inquiries, questions, and/or other requests. If User decides to opt-in to our mailing list, they will receive emails that may include company news, updates, related product or service information, etc. If at any time the User would like to unsubscribe from receiving future emails, we include detailed unsubscribe instructions at the bottom of each email or User may contact us via our Site.

We adopt appropriate data collection, storage and processing practices and security measures to protect against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction of your personal information, username, password, transaction information and data stored on our Site.
Sensitive and private data exchange between the Site and its Users happens over a SSL secured communication channel and is encrypted and protected with digital signatures.

We do not sell, trade, or rent Users personal identification information to others. We may share generic aggregated demographic information not linked to any personal identification information regarding visitors and users with our business partners, trusted affiliates and advertisers for the purposes outlined above.

Users may find advertising or other content on our Site that link to the sites and services of our partners, suppliers, advertisers, sponsors, licensors and other third parties. We do not control the content or links that appear on these sites and are not responsible for the practices employed by websites linked to or from our Site. In addition, these sites or services, including their content and links, may be constantly changing. These sites and services may have their own privacy policies and customer service policies. Browsing and interaction on any other website, including websites which have a link to our Site, is subject to that website's own terms and policies.

The Lembongan Traveller has the discretion to update this privacy policy at any time. When we do, we will revise the updated date at the bottom of this page. We encourage Users to frequently check this page for any changes to stay informed about how we are helping to protect the personal information we collect. You acknowledge and agree that it is your responsibility to review this privacy policy periodically and become aware of modifications.

By using this Site, you signify your acceptance of this policy and terms of service. If you do not agree to this policy, please do not use our Site. Your continued use of the Site following the posting of changes to this policy will be deemed your acceptance of those changes.
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, the practices of this site, or your dealings with this site, please contact us at:

Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://www.thelembongantraveller.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’
column9:
s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymised string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "
column11:
, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognise and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]There are a number of places you can exchange money on the island, including one on the main road in front of the Indiana gang in Jungut Batu.  Most resorts and restaurants accept credit cards, however cash is required for scooter hire, snorkelling and other day trips. There are a number of ATMs on Nusa Lembongan, but please note they have a cap on the amount you can withdraw &amp
column3: do sometimes run out of money. So best to have some CASH!

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Is there a doctor on the island?"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535103653010{margin-top: -30px !important
column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]If you require medical attention whilst on Lembongan we recommend East Medical Clinic in Mushroom Bay, it is a private practice open 24 hours, 7 days a week.  Whats App +62 813 3955 5515

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Let's help the environment"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535103763825{margin-top: -30px !important
column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]As with so many places, Lembongan is trying to minimise the use of plastic on the island. There are some easy ways you can do your bit to help
column3: bring a re-usable water bottle to avoid having to use plastic water bottles. Also say no to plastic bags when you shop locally, bring a carry bag with you to use rather than accepting a plastic bag.

column1: Water on Lembongan is a scarce resource, so we ask you to think carefully when showering, trying to restrict length of showers and how many you have a day.  This concept also applies to laundering and only request new towels when really needed. Every little bit counts.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Swimming in Lembongan"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535103802006{margin-top: -30px !important
column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Care is to be taken when swimming in any waters around Nusa Lembongan as there are extremely variable tides and strong currents. Mushroom Bay tends to have less currents than other areas. Swimming at Dream Beach should be avoided by all but the very strongest of swimmers, and even then with caution. Due to strong currents and tidal changes surfing at all four breaks can be challenging for beginners.  We also ask you take care when visiting Devils Tear and other ocean fronting sights, as freak waves can occur.  CLICK HERE to read our blog about Lembongan Beaches.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Transport on Lembongan"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535103837902{margin-top: -30px !important
column3: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan is approximately 8km2, with roads linking villas, hotels, restaurants, &
column4: attractions. Scooters are widely available for hire and are the main form of transport around the island.  For those not comfortable driving themselves, willing locals are also more than happy to transport you on the back of their motorbike for a fee. If scooters are not for you, gasoline cars and bicycles are available for hire and guided tours.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Is Lembongan good for kids?"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535103875377{margin-top: -30px !important
column5: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan is a great place to bring children of all ages. It’s a very safe island and the locals adore children. Be sure to always supervise your children when swimming as the tidal movements and currents can cause issues when unaware of the changing conditions. Choosing your accommodation to suit the needs of your children is one way to ensure the whole family have a great holiday. Decide if you are best suited to a resort style set up with a larger swimming pool or prefer a villa with a private pool.  If you have younger children, there are babysitting services and we can also assist with pool fences.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Getting to and from Restaurants"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109223572{margin-top: -30px !important
column6: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]The majority of restaurants on Lembongan offer a FREE pick up and drop off service.  This is very handy for families and also those wanting to have a couple of cocktails. Our Restaurant Guide has menus, locations and contact details for all our favourite restaurants on Nusa Lembongan &

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Should I bring or rent a surfboard?"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109214598{margin-top: -30px !important
column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]This is a personal decision and depends upon many factors including how long you plan to stay, your daily budget and how  long your board is!! There are a number of Surf Schools in Jungut Batu &
column3: Mushroom Bay which rent surf boards. The boards are generally in good shape and a selection of sizes and styles are on offer, including long, short, and soft boards, boogie boards and stand up paddle boards.

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Can I get early check in / later check out?"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109202605{margin-top: -30px !important
column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]We understand everyone wants to spend as much time as possible island side.  Early check in will always be offered if available, but depends if guests are checking out the same day to give staff time to prepare for your arrival.  Similar for late check out.  Always touch base a few days prior to your arrival.  Noting, standard check in time is 2pm and check out is 10am.  If you are staying at a resort they will always be happy to hold your bags for you until your room is ready or so you can enjoy exploring the island on your last day.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation="""" bg_type=""no_bg""][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Getting to and from Nusa Lembongan"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109371207{margin-top: -30px !important
column3: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan is approximately a 30 minute boat trip from Sanur, Bali. Boats leave up to 4 times daily. Please take a look at our boat transfers page for detailed information about boat options to and from Nusa Lembongan.

column1: Depending on your flight schedule or travel plans it is sometimes necessary to overnight in Bali to make connecting boat / flight times.  See HERE for link to hotels in Bali we recommend.

column2: > [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Wifi on Lembongan"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109361330{margin-top: -30px !important
column3: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]WIFI is available at the majority of restaurants and accommodation. However, be mindful that download speeds do vary, can be slower at times, as servers are located in Bali.  As a whole the island offers consistent wifi capable for online work. If it does drop out, take it as a sign to log off-line and  enjoy island life![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Visa on Arrival"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109352375{margin-top: -30px !important
column4: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Visa On Arrival needs to be purchased at Denpasar airport prior to going through immigration.

column1: Ensure your passport has 6 months validity other wise you will not be able to travel to Indonesia.

We also strongly recommend you have travel insurance, ideally taking it out when you make your booking to cover you for any unforeseen circumstances.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_bottom=""32"" css_animation="""" bg_type=""no_bg""][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Lembongan locals"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109517616{margin-top: -30px !important
column2: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan is a remote idyllic island and some things are not the way we are use to at home. Theisland can experience interminent power cuts, many accommodation and restaurants have generators to assist at these times. Religious &amp
column3: cultural ceremonies always take precedence over work for the local people, so please be patient if things happen on “island time”.

column1: Most importantly please don’t forget..….the two local villages of Jungut Batu and Lembongan are home to the beautiful, hard working people who have embraced visitors and allow us to share their island paradise.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""Religion, Culture &
column2: Language"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109507824{margin-top: -30px !important
column3: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]The majority of local people are Hindu. Traditions and religious ceremonies are part of everyday life, you will undoubtedly see at least one during your stay. They are extremely colourful, lively (and loud) events. Respect for the locals during these occasions is appreciated and best shown by thoughtful observance. Balinese is the most common language of communication between local residents. English is widely understood and spoken, often with an Australian accent![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width=""1/3""][icon_text box_type=""normal"" icon_pack=""font_awesome"" fa_icon=""fa-arrow-right"" icon_type=""normal"" icon_size=""fa-lg"" icon_position=""left_from_title"" title=""FREE Island App"" title_tag=""h4"" icon_color=""#00a79b"" title_color=""#333740""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation="""" css="".vc_custom_1535109497017{margin-top: -30px !important
column4: }""][vc_column_inner][vc_column_text]Our FREE Island App is your essential guide to Nusa Lembongan. WELCOME TO JETSKI LEMBONGAN ADVENTURE, the ultimate island hopping experience !
Ride your own Jetski and explore Lembongan, Penida and Ceningan highlight’s in a fun way! All our tours are guided with a professional captain.

There are 4 guided safari tour options to give you the opportunity to explore the islands in your own favourite way. During the trip, participants typically follow a guide who leads the group to different locations of interest, highlighting points of natural beauty or simply providing a fun and exhilarating experience on the water.

Our safaris include stops at scenic spots like YELLOW BRIDGE, CRYSTAL BAY, BROKEN BEACH, KELINGKING BEACH, brief breaks for swimming on secret beaches, and opportunities to observe wildlife (especially dolphins or manta ray) or landmarks along the route.

Depending on your wishes and levels, you could choose the ride fitting with your expectations: focus on sightseeing or be more adventurous with high-speed rides, simply discover the pleasure of the activity or enjoy the sunset from the sea. Always with safety measures, for all the rides we provide life jacket, goggles, cloves, shoes and follow local boating regulations, to ensure a secure and enjoyable experience. All our jetskis are brand new (Seadoo GTX Pro 130, 1.630cc).

Nusa Lembongan, Ceningan and Penida are stunningly beautiful destinations with plenty to offer for anyone who loves natural beauty. And there’s no better way to explore these islands than with Jetski Lembongan Adventure. From crystal clear waters to colourful coral reefs, stunning rock formations, and white sandy beaches, there’s something for everyone on these islands.

Our crafted safari packages – Blue Lagoon Ride, Fun Ride, Island Escape, Penida Pulse and Full Trip – blend excitement, enjoyment, and wonder. Bring back wonderful photos of your experience captured by your guide during your ride.
Contact us and get some more explanation about our ways to ride through the islands and have FUN !!

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#f5f5f5""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Have you been searching for the perfect Nusa Lembongan accommodation or for a different choice of Bali accommodation?  At The Lembongan Traveller we take care of all your Lembongan accommodation needs and handle boat transfers from mainland Bali.  We list a wide range of accommodation choices for Nusa Lembongan villas, resorts, hotels and bungalows to suit any budget. With a wealth of knowledge on all things Nusa Lembongan, we are the ultimate guides and will make your island escape one to remember.  Allow us to assist you with all you need to know about booking accommodation on this beautiful holiday destination.

If you dream of a real island holiday with crystal clear waters and a relaxed village vibe then an escape to Nusa Lembongan is the perfect answer. Just a 30 minute boat ride from Bali, Nusa Lembongan is an idyllic island where you can forget the hustle and bustle of mainland Bali.  An island where the days of old Indonesia are blended harmoniously with the comforts of Nusa Lembongan resort and villa accommodation. Here relaxation and adventure go hand in hand. Nusa Lembongan, Bali has a truly relaxed island atmosphere and will have you feeling like you are miles away from the stresses of life.  The waters are clean and pristine, making Nusa Lembongan a water playground.  Ocean activities take front row with surfing, snorkelling, diving and paddle boarding a popular way to spend the day for holidaymakers and families.

Picture yourself relaxing in your Nusa Lembongan hotel accommodation gazing over turquoise seas, the sound of waves breaking and a mild tropical heat warming your skin.  A rooster can be heard faintly crowing from a local village. The smell of handmade banana pancakes tickles your nose as you ponder the day's activities.  Perhaps a traditional boat ride and snorkelling in the temperate waters where tropical fish abound is on the cards?  Or maybe surfing the infamous breaks of Playgrounds, Shipwrecks or Lacerations are more your style?  Or is it time to unwind poolside in your Lembongan villa and allow your staff to attend to your needs.
If your next Bali holiday break sounds something like this contact us to book your Nusa Lembongan Accommodation.

Vedanta provides premium private transfers between Bali and the surrounding islands aboard Indonesia's most sophisticated speedboat. Choose your preferred time for departure from Serangan Harbor, where our professional team will welcome you for a seamless check-in experience. Enjoy the journey at thrilling speeds of up to 42 knots while experiencing unparalleled comfort in our air-conditioned cabin. We can assist with arranging private transportation to and from the harbor to complete your door-to-door service.

Beyond standard transfers, Vedanta offers customized experiences including surf trips, snorkeling excursions, and island-hopping adventures. Design your perfect day on the water with our expert team, whether it's a quick transfer or a full-day exploration of Indonesia's most stunning locations.
• Premium amenities: air-conditioned cabin, Zipwake Dynamic Stability System
• Included: professional crew, self-inflating life jackets, Fusion audio system, bottled water, soft drinks, snacks, towels
• Optimal safety: night vision capability, ISO and ABYC compliant
Additional routes available to G-Land, West Sumbawa, Moyo, and Sumba upon request. Each transfer includes premium service with flexible departure times to suit your schedule.
Final invoice would be converted to IDR based on today’s exchange rate. All the prices exclude 11% tax.
• Please book a minimum of 12 hours before departure.
• Boat operation time : anytime between 6:30 AM – 5:30 PM.
• Land transfers in Bali and Nusa Lembongan excluded.
• Departure and arrival point in Bali is Serangan port.

""name"": ""Setia Fast Ferry – Bali to Nusa Lembongan Transfer"",

""description"": ""Book your fast ferry transfer from Sanur, Bali to Jungutbatu, Nusa Lembongan with D'Stars Fast Ferry. Just 30 minutes by boat. Includes free hotel pick-up and drop-off, luggage, and accommodation transfer on Nusa Lembongan."",
""name"": ""Setia Fast ferry Ticket – Bali to Nusa Lembongan"",

""description"": ""Fast ferry boat transfer from Sanur, Bali to Nusa Lembongan in approximately 30 minutes. Includes free hotel pick-up from Airport, Sanur, Kuta, Legian, Seminyak, Petitenget, Nusa Dua, Jimbaran, Ketewel, and Keramas. Luggage and surfboards included."",

""value"": ""Free from Airport, Sanur, Kuta, Legian, Seminyak, Petitenget, Nusa Dua, Jimbaran, Ketewel, Keramas""
""name"": ""Setia Fast Ferry Booking via The Lembongan Traveller"",

""description"": ""The Lembongan Traveller arranges Setia Fast Ferry transfers between Sanur Harbour, Bali and Jungutbatu, Nusa Lembongan. All shared land transfers on Lembongan are included unless otherwise arranged."",

""termsOfService"": ""Please be at the harbour 30 minutes prior to departure. All land transfers on Lembongan are shared unless otherwise arranged. Check-in for accommodation is at 2 PM and check-out at 10 AM.""
""name"": ""How long is the Setia Fast Ferry from Bali to Nusa Lembongan?"",
""text"": ""The The Setia Fast Ferry takes approximately 30 minutes from Sanur Harbour, Bali to Jungutbatu Beach, Nusa Lembongan.""
""name"": ""How many times per day does Setia Fast Ferry depart?"",
""text"": ""Setia Fast Ferry offers 3 departure times daily from both Sanur, Bali and Nusa Lembongan.""
""name"": ""Does the Setia Fast Ferry include hotel pick-up from Bali?"",

""text"": ""Yes. Free hotel pick-up and drop-off is included from the Airport, Sanur, Kuta, Legian, Seminyak, Petitenget, Nusa Dua, Jimbaran, Ketewel, and Keramas. Other areas are available at an additional cost.""
""name"": ""Is luggage included in the Setia Fast Ferry ticket price?"",
""text"": ""Yes. Boat transfer tickets include all luggage and surfboards as part of the ticketing price at no extra charge.""
""name"": ""Where does Setia Fast Ferry arrive in Nusa Lembongan?"",
""text"": ""Setia Fast Ferry arrives at Jungutbatu Beach, the main bay of Nusa Lembongan, which is centrally located near most accommodations.""
""name"": ""How early should I arrive before the Setia Fast Ferry departure?"",
""text"": ""You should be at the harbour 30 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time. If you have arranged accommodation pick-up on Nusa Lembongan, be ready one hour before departure.""

column1: [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#f5f5f5""][vc_column][vc_column_text]Have you been searching for the perfect Nusa Lembongan accommodation or for a different choice of Bali accommodation?  At The Lembongan Traveller we take care of all your Lembongan accommodation needs and handle boat transfers from mainland Bali.  We list a wide range of accommodation choices for Nusa Lembongan villas, resorts, hotels and bungalows to suit any budget. With a wealth of knowledge on all things Nusa Lembongan, we are the ultimate guides and will make your island escape one to remember.  Allow us to assist you with all you need to know about booking accommodation on this beautiful holiday destination.

If you dream of a real island holiday with crystal clear waters and a relaxed village vibe then an escape to Nusa Lembongan is the perfect answer. Just a 30 minute boat ride from Bali, Nusa Lembongan is an idyllic island where you can forget the hustle and bustle of mainland Bali.  An island where the days of old Indonesia are blended harmoniously with the comforts of Nusa Lembongan resort and villa accommodation. Here relaxation and adventure go hand in hand. Nusa Lembongan, Bali has a truly relaxed island atmosphere and will have you feeling like you are miles away from the stresses of life.  The waters are clean and pristine, making Nusa Lembongan a water playground.  Ocean activities take front row with surfing, snorkelling, diving and paddle boarding a popular way to spend the day for holidaymakers and families.

Picture yourself relaxing in your Nusa Lembongan hotel accommodation gazing over turquoise seas, the sound of waves breaking and a mild tropical heat warming your skin.  A rooster can be heard faintly crowing from a local village. The smell of handmade banana pancakes tickles your nose as you ponder the day's activities.  Perhaps a traditional boat ride and snorkelling in the temperate waters where tropical fish abound is on the cards?  Or maybe surfing the infamous breaks of Playgrounds, Shipwrecks or Lacerations are more your style?  Or is it time to unwind poolside in your Lembongan villa and allow your staff to attend to your needs.
If your next Bali holiday break sounds something like this contact us to book your Nusa Lembongan Accommodation.

We are a trusted Australian owned and Australian based business and match all online prices.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""80"" padding_bottom=""40"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_column_text]Nusa Lembongan feels like a glimpse of Bali in the old days — crystal-clear waters, local kids playing by the beach, and sandy-foot dinners at casual seaside barbecues. Just 30 minutes from Bali, this peaceful island is easily accessible from Sanur port. The journey is smooth, safe, and worth every minute. When you arrive, turquoise waters and a laid-back village atmosphere greet you. [/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""""]At The Lembongan Traveller, we're more than just a travel platform. We're a passionate team who live and breathe Nusa Lembongan. Since launching in 2013 as a humble Instagram page, we've grown into a boutique property management company with a full-service website, thriving social media, and our very own app. With an Australian founder and a team based right here on the island, our office is open seven days a week to help you experience the very best of Lembongan, because we know this island like the back of our hand.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height=""64px""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/2""][image_with_text title=""Tania - Founder"" image=""59189""]What's the best part about living in Lembongan?

column2: >Being part of a small, thriving community, surrounded by the ocean and having nasi campur for lunch everyday![/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/2""][image_with_text title=""Mal - Founder"" image=""59196""]Where's your favourite surf break and why?

>Playgrounds, fun wave and  it's a short paddle from Coconut Beach.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type=""normal"" border_style=""""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/2""][image_with_text title=""Asni - CEO"" image=""76963""]If you were a brand ambassador for this island... which warung would you represent?

column3: It showcases the essence of a traditional Indonesian warung, offering a creatively twisted Indonesian menu designed (including vegans) to appeal to palates from around the globe.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/2""][image_with_text title=""Bulan - Director of Sales &
column4: Marketing"" image=""76964""]What draws you to Lembongan?

column2: >There's infinite opportunity on this little island and whilst it's only 30 minutes from Bali, the vibe feels different - more raw and real.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type=""normal"" border_style=""""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/3""][image_with_text image=""66526"" title=""Sudi - Operations Manager""]What do you miss the most from the island when you lived on the main island?

>I miss the tranquility, natural beauty, local community connection and ocean breezes from the island while I am on the mainland.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/3""][image_with_text title=""Juni - Assistant Operations Manager"" image=""59197""]Tell us your favourite place to hang out ...

>The Old Tree beach in Nusa Ceningan.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/3""][image_with_text title=""Ade - Assistant Operations Manager"" image=""73651""]What sport do you usually do to stay active on the island?

>I usually play badminton and padel, but running is the sport I do most often. The feeling of running along the trail at Devil’s Tear is unbeatable.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type=""normal"" border_style=""""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text title=""Titis - Reservations Manager"" image=""76966""]What makes Lembongan a great place to visit for a family?

>Lembongan has everything - it's a short distance from Bali with nice beaches and it's easy to walk everywhere.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text title=""Visia - Reservations Supervisor"" image=""76968""]What do few people know about Lembongan?

>We have Sea Silence Day here, a holy day to pay respect to the Sea God and a day where the ocean takes a 'pause', no swimming, snorkelling or boat activities are allowed on this auspicious day.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text title=""Dede - Reservations"" image=""71289""]What's your most recommended thing to do on Lembongan?

>Get a Seaweed Farming experience. Watching, enjoying the vibes, even try to do it with the local farmer.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text image=""72471"" title=""Anjas - Reservations""]As a Ceningan local, do you have a favourite secret spot?

>Parangan Jepang. The best spot for rock fishing in Ceningan. Ask the locals if you don’t want to get lost.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_separator type=""normal"" border_style=""""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text title=""Okta - Finance"" image=""59187""]What's your favourite beach in Lembongan?

>I have two actually : Song Lambung, a rather hidden beach that feels private and one near Dream Beach area... I can't tell you this secret location though![/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text image=""76965"" title=""Ega - Finance""]I spent my childhood...

>Visiting Gala-gala Cave on Galungan holiday![/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text title=""Nanda - Finance"" image=""75964""]What's your recommendation for Lembongan first-timer?
>Visit Sundeck by Lago.[/image_with_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=""1/4""][image_with_text title=""Yuda - Procurement"" image=""59192""]Must-place visit in Lembongan is ...

Home to some of the best Nusa Lembongan luxury villas, Tamarind Bay is especially popular with families or groups looking to spend quality time in the villa.

Most of the villas in the area offer multiple bedrooms and facilities such as bunk room, game room as well as in-villa dining options so you can enjoy delicious meals prepared by the staff without having to venture out to eat.
From the beach, you can paddle to Playgrounds and Lacerations surf breaks in just a few minutes, making it a favourite locale for surfers and water sport enthusiasts alike.

Tamarind Bay is also a great spot for snorkelling tours on Nusa Lembongan, with boats departing directly from the beach (depending on sea conditions).This makes it an ideal base for exploring the underwater wonders of the island without having to go too far from your front door.
If you are in the mood for a unique dining experience, head over to The Playful Table, a mostly plant-based restaurant just a short walk over the nearby headland.
Just steps from Tamarind Beach, Tales Bookcafé is a cozy spot for coffee, good food, secondhand books, and board games—perfect for slow mornings, story swaps, and Thursday night game sessions.

For a change of scenery, continue your stroll over the headland to Coconut Beach, which connects you to the boardwalk and Jungutbatu Beach. Here you will find countless restaurants and activities for the whole family. While making your way along the boardwalk, you’ll find Spring Spa, touted as one of the best spas on Nusa Lembongan.

With its blissful ambience, luxurious accommodations, and convenient access to activities, staying in Tamarind Bay should definitely be on your list when choosing your next Nusa Lembongan private villa.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height=""20px""][/vc_column][/vc_row]",,2025-06-13,page,https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/tamarind-bay-accommodations/,,,,,,,,true,,0,,no,no,no,no,default,,,,,,,60,,2,,yes,bellow_title,0,default,,,,,,,"Tamarind Bay is a peaceful Nusa Lembongan gem with calm waters and top villas—perfect for families or groups seeking a relaxing island escape.",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,publish,2,"The Lembongan Traveller",holiday@thelembongantraveller.com,,,tamarind-bay-accommodations,,,0,0,0,closed,closed,2025-06-13

column2: >Dreaming of a festive escape to Nusa Lembongan?

>It’s not too late to secure your island getaway. While many villas are already booked, we’ve gathered a selection of beautiful stays that still have availability this holiday season. From lively Jungutbatu to the serene sands of Sandy Bay, Tamarind Beach, Mushroom Bay, and across the Yellow Bridge to Nusa Ceningan – your festive island retreat awaits.

If you dream of a real island holiday with crystal clear waters and a relaxed village vibe then an escape to Nusa Lembongan is the perfect answer. Just a 30 minute boat ride from Bali, Nusa Lembongan is an idyllic island where you can forget the hustle and bustle of mainland Bali.  An island where the days of old Indonesia are blended harmoniously with the comforts of Nusa Lembongan resort and villa accommodation. Here relaxation and adventure go hand in hand. Nusa Lembongan, Bali has a truly relaxed island atmosphere and will have you feeling like you are miles away from the stresses of life.  The waters are clean and pristine, making Nusa Lembongan a water playground.  Ocean activities take front row with surfing, snorkelling, diving and paddle boarding a popular way to spend the day for holidaymakers and families.

Picture yourself relaxing in your Nusa Lembongan hotel accommodation gazing over turquoise seas, the sound of waves breaking and a mild tropical heat warming your skin.  A rooster can be heard faintly crowing from a local village. The smell of handmade banana pancakes tickles your nose as you ponder the day's activities.  Perhaps a traditional boat ride and snorkelling in the temperate waters where tropical fish abound is on the cards?  Or maybe surfing the infamous breaks of Playgrounds, Shipwrecks or Lacerations are more your style?  Or is it time to unwind poolside in your Lembongan villa and allow your staff to attend to your needs.

Nusa Lembongan has become one of Bali's most sought-after retreat destinations. Just 30 minutes by fast boat from Bali, the island offers a peaceful setting for yoga retreats, wellness escapes, corporate team retreats, surf camps, and private group getaways.
Unlike mainland Bali, Nusa Lembongan offers:
• Yoga and wellness facilities
• Private villas for groups
• Easy access from Bali

Whether you're planning a corporate retreat, yoga retreat, women's retreat, surf retreat, or family gathering, Nusa Lembongan provides a relaxed island environment that encourages connection, wellness, and adventure.

Tell us your group size and we'll match you with the right options.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""Is Nusa Lembongan suitable for yoga retreats?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]Absolutely — it's one of the best spots in Indonesia for it. Many of our villas have open-air pavilions or gardens that double perfectly as yoga shalas. The island's relaxed rhythm and natural beauty set exactly the right tone.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""How do we get to Nusa Lembongan?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]The most common route is a fast boat from Sanur, Bali — around 30–45 minutes. We can book transfers for your whole group and you'll receive 20% off as a retreat booking perk. Boats run multiple times a day.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""Can you help us plan the retreat schedule?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]Yes! We can recommend mix of activities and trusted partners — snorkelling, island tours, cooking classes, beach time, or just space to breathe. We know the island well and can point you toward the best experiences.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""Can you cater for special diets and dietary requirements?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]Our private chef partners are experienced with all dietary needs — vegan, gluten-free, plant-based, and more. Just let us know when you enquire and we'll make sure your group is well fed.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""What's the best time of year to visit?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]The dry season (May–October) brings blue skies, calm seas, and excellent visibility for snorkelling and diving — ideal for most retreats. The wet season (November–April) is greener and quieter, with lower rates and a more intimate feel. We can advise based on your priorities.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""What is the best area in Nusa Lembongan for a retreat?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]The best area depends on the style of retreat you're planning. Tamarind Bay offers a peaceful setting ideal for yoga and wellness retreats, while Jungutbatu is perfect for groups wanting easy access to restaurants, cafés, and island activities. Sandy Bay is popular for luxury retreats with stunning ocean views, and nearby Nusa Ceningan provides a more secluded atmosphere for private group escapes. With a variety of beachfront villas, boutique resorts, and private venues across the islands, Nusa Lembongan offers retreat locations to suit groups of all sizes and interests.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""What is the best retreat venue in Nusa Lembongan?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]The best retreat venue depends on your group size, retreat style and preferred location. Beachfront villas, private estates and boutique resorts across Tamarind Bay, Jungutbatu, Sandy Bay and Nusa Ceningan can accommodate everything from intimate wellness retreats to larger group events.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""What are the recommended activities to do on Nusa Lembongan?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
There are plenty of activities to enjoy on the island and we can help connect you with our trusted local partners to make planning effortless.

Start your day with a yoga session overlooking the ocean, challenge your group to a game of padel, or embrace the island lifestyle with surfing, fishing, and snorkelling adventures. For those seeking relaxation, unwind with a sauna and ice bath experience while soaking in the laid-back island atmosphere.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""Is internet connectivity reliable enough for a working retreat?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]Most accommodations have reliable Wi-Fi powered by Starlink, and the island's connectivity has improved significantly. For high-demand groups (digital nomad or creative retreats), we can advise on the best-connected properties.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""How far in advance should we book?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]For group retreats, we recommend booking at least 3–6 months ahead, especially during peak season (July–August and Christmas/New Year). Last-minute bookings can work for smaller groups — reach out and we'll see what's available.[/vc_column_text][/vc_accordion_tab][vc_accordion_tab title=""Do I need a visa to run a retreat on Nusa Lembongan?"" title_color=""#000000"" background_color=""#D2D2D2""][vc_column_text css=""""]

Yes. If you're organising and running a retreat in Indonesia, you'll need a C7C Visa, which is the appropriate visa for conducting retreat activities. It is the responsibility of each retreat organiser to obtain the correct visa before operating in Indonesia. The Lembongan Traveller is not responsible for visa applications or arrangements. We recommend consulting a licensed visa agent or immigration consultant to ensure you have the correct documentation in place before confirming your retreat.

Dcamel ALX is a newly introduced fast boat by PT. Dcamel Wisata Samudra Nusa, designed to deliver both speed and comfort across the islands. Built with a lightweight aluminium structure and powered by three VOLVO 850hp engines, the vessel reaches speeds of up to 35 knots and accommodates up to 193 passengers.
Connecting Nusa Lembongan with Gili Trawangan and Gili Air, Dcamel ALX makes island hopping seamless and efficient—perfect for travellers looking to explore more without the hassle.

Onboard, guests can enjoy a comfortable journey with air conditioning, a bathroom, television, and music entertainment. For those wanting to take in the scenery, the upper deck offers beautiful ocean views, turning your transfer into part of the experience itself.
